scope: On the Becoming core's laws of undominated members of a listed menu: in RelationalOrganization, on an exact listed menu the frontier of PracticalJudgment is the core's undominated members (frontier_iff_undominated); with Lean's classical decidedness supplying what the core asks, the frontier is not empty by exists_undominated and every member includes the organizational relation by undominated_has, so formation_required_of_improvable_absence follows from the core laws (formation_required_by_core), and so does the constructed case (coordination_is_required_by_core).
